params.name: acquisition_check
params.description: Check the acquisition before tagging. Raw DIA, whose MS2 'precursors' are isolation windows holding several peptides, is refused with exit code 11 (refuse), tagged anyway with a warning as before 1.12 (warn), or not checked (off). Tag DIA through pseudo-DDA spectra instead: run DIAspeXtract (or diaTracer for .d) first; their output passes the check

params.name: acquisition_probe_spectra
params.description: MS2 spectra the acquisition check reads (metadata only) from the start of the run, reading at most ten times as many spectra in all; a mixed file is judged on these

params.name: alkylation_min_share
params.description: Share of the binned spectra the -alkylation_out call needs

params.name: alkylation_min_spectra
params.description: Spectra the -alkylation_out call needs, binned and for the called class

params.name: alkylation_out
params.description: Report which reagent alkylated the cysteines (or none), from the placements of single-Cys peptides on -recon_fasta or -alkylation_proteome: Cys form counts and the call (not validated on held-out data)

params.name: alkylation_proteome
params.description: Database of -alkylation_out without -recon_fasta: a FASTA file (.gz allowed). The names auto (= human), human, mouse, yeast and ecoli stand for shipped proteomes, which 1.12.0 does not ship: they stop with exit code 6, so give a FASTA file here or -recon_fasta

params.name: alkylation_window
params.description: Window of -alkylation_out around each Cys form mass; 0 = 0.02 Da on a ppm run, 0.5 Da on a run with a Da fragment tolerance

params.name: census
params.description: Write a census: one row per MS2 spectrum read (status, peak and tag facts, tagged or not) to <out> with its extension replaced by .census.tsv, and a run summary to .census_summary.tsv. A status is not a quality call. Subsampling counts input spectra of all MS levels

params.name: census_ids
params.description: Identifications of -in (idXML or mzid) for -census: adds the columns identified (1, 0, empty = unknown) and triage, and a census_ids section to the summary. A spectrum is identified by a target hit whose q-value passes -census_ids_fdr; a file without q-values is refused (filter it with IDFilter first)

params.name: census_ids_fdr
params.description: q-value a target hit of -census_ids needs to identify its spectrum

params.name: census_out
params.description: Per-spectrum census table. Default: <out> with its extension replaced by .census.tsv

params.name: census_summary_out
params.description: Census run summary (section, key, value, n, description). Default: <out> with its extension replaced by .census_summary.tsv

params.name: census_triage_evalue
params.description: best_evalue at or below which an unidentified tagged or placed spectrum is a triage candidate (an E-value threshold, not a quality call)

params.name: charge_infer_margin
params.description: Complement-pair excess by which the inferred charge must beat the runner-up to be tagged alone; closer, both are tagged (ambiguous). Any excess above 0 is a call

params.name: charge_max
params.description: Highest charge -unknown_charge enumerate or infer tries

params.name: charge_min
params.description: Lowest charge -unknown_charge enumerate or infer tries (1 enables infer's 1+ test)

params.name: complement_midp
params.description: Score complements with DirecTag's hypergeometric mid-p P(X>c) + P(X=c)/2 for tags with 0 or 1 complemented peaks; 2 or more keep P(X>=c)

params.name: complement_rule
params.description: Which fragment pairs count as complements in the complement subscore: same_charge (both at the fragment charge z, partner at M/z + 2p - m), precursor (the partner carries the precursor's remaining c - z charges, at (M + c*p - z*m)/(c - z)), or both (either rule)

params.name: complement_tol_factor
params.description: Factor k of the complement window k*(fragment tolerance at the peak + at the partner) (used with -complement_tolerance_unit fragment)

params.name: complement_tolerance
params.description: Window for a complement partner in Da (used with -complement_tolerance_unit Da)

params.name: complement_tolerance_unit
params.description: Da: the window is -complement_tolerance. fragment: -complement_tol_factor scales the run's -fragment_tolerance at both partners

params.name: debug
params.description: Sets the debug level

params.name: delta_out
params.description: Aggregated mass-shift histogram over the reconciliations (requires -recon_out): delta, spectrum count, top interpretations. Region-level candidates, NOT localized identifications and NOT FDR-controlled

params.name: digest_background_share
params.description: Share of the background mixed into every protease model (below 1)

params.name: digest_calibration
params.description: Calibration of p_correct for -digest_out (columns feature, coef). Default: the shipped digest_calibration.tsv when p_correct is written

params.name: digest_detection
params.description: Per-instrument detection weights of -digest_out from the model table: 'shipped' applies them and calls timsTOF runs instead of withholding them (needs a v2 table; not validated on held-out data); 'none' = 1.11

params.name: digest_flank2
params.description: Two-residue flank model of -digest_out: 'auto' scores the flank sums m(P2) + m(P1) when the P1 counts are too few or y1 is cut off (not validated on held-out data); 'off' = 1.11

params.name: digest_min_confidence
params.description: Withhold a -digest_out call whose calibrated p_correct is below this (no_call low_confidence); 0 = off. Not validated on held-out data

params.name: digest_models
params.description: Protease model table for -digest_out (columns model, class, end, residue, freq). Default: the shipped cleavage-rule models

params.name: digest_models_version
params.description: Shipped protease models of -digest_out: 'shipped' (1.11) or 'v2' (detection, LysargiNase and Asp-N_ambic rows, pooled specificity; not validated on held-out data)

params.name: digest_out
params.description: Report the terminal residues of the tags (ungapped, E-value <= 1) and the protease call they support, with its margin or the reason for no call

params.name: digest_silac_min
params.description: K- and R-terminal tag ends each before -label_out's heavy shares are gated in

params.name: digest_tag_min
params.description: Tag ends needed for a protease call; the N-terminal ends count from as many

params.name: digest_window
params.description: Mass window around a residue or label mass at the tag ends

params.name: diversity
params.description: On spectra with more tags than -max_tags, prefer tags built from different peaks over near-copies of a tag already kept. Changes which tags fill the slots, not how many

params.name: dump_spectrum
params.description: Print the peaks FASTag tags of the spectrum of -in with this native ID (after centroiding, the precursor cut, deisotoping and the peak budget, under the options given) as JSON lines and exit; needs no -out. Prepares the given precursor at its charge (or 2+) only

params.name: entrapment_fasta
params.description: Entrapment database (foreign species the sample cannot contain; phylogenetically distant, e.g. archaea for a mammalian sample). Requires -fasta. Appends a q_db column and marks entrapment-only matches efwd/erev in fasta_hit

params.name: extension
params.description: Maximum residues appended per terminus; 0 disables extension

params.name: fasta
params.description: Report only tags occurring in these sequences

params.name: fasta_out
params.description: Reduced FASTA: the shortlisted proteins of the database (no decoys; let the search engine generate them), then -shortlist_background

params.name: fixed_modifications
params.description: Fixed modifications by OpenMS/UniMod name, e.g. 'Carbamidomethyl (C)' 'TMT6plex (K)'. Shift residue masses; not annotated in the tag

params.name: force
params.description: Overrides tool-specific checks

params.name: fragment_tolerance
params.description: Fragment mass tolerance

params.name: fragment_tolerance_unit
params.description: Tolerance unit

params.name: gap_penalty
params.description: Rank gapped tags as if their E-value were this many times worse. Never removes a tag at the -max_evalue cutoff (applied to the unpenalised value), but under -max_tags it decides which tags fill the capped slots, and a gapped row's printed evalue includes it. 1 disables

params.name: gaps
params.description: Allow a tag to cross one missing peak, spelling the two residues either side of it from their summed mass; 0 disables

params.name: glyco
params.description: Flag oxonium-bearing MS2 spectra (glycopeptide/glycan evidence, NOT an identification) to <out> with its extension replaced by .glyco.tsv (tags.tsv -> tags.glyco.tsv), or to -glyco_out

params.name: glyco_min_fraction
params.description: Minimum summed oxonium intensity as a fraction of the base peak (MSFragger-Glyco's diagnostic filter)

params.name: glyco_out
params.description: Per-spectrum oxonium report. Default: <out> with its extension replaced by .glyco.tsv

params.name: in
params.description: Input spectra (mzML, mzpeak or MGF)

params.name: ion_series
params.description: Ion series the MS2 spectra are read as: by (b/y ions, as before 1.12), cz (c/z-dot ions of electron transfer or capture dissociation, ETD/ECD), or auto (c/z-dot for spectra whose activation is ETD or ECD, b/y for all others, hybrid EThcD/ETciD included). Under cz and auto the tag TSV gains an ion_series column when some spectrum can be read as c/z

params.name: isobaric_tolerance
params.description: When matching against -fasta or reconciling against -recon_fasta, treat a residue as interchangeable with an isobaric residue pair within this tolerance; 0 requires exact strings

params.name: isotope_error
params.description: Precursor isotope offsets (-1..3) to consider: the precursor mass is lowered by k x 1.00336 Da, for every precursor; each charge is tagged at the offset its complement pairs support best. Needs a fragment tolerance below 0.05 Da

params.name: label_discovery_depth
params.description: Most residues a -label_discovery_out channel-peak explanation names (0, 1 or 2)

params.name: label_discovery_max_flank
params.description: Largest flank mass -label_discovery_out histograms, and the largest composition mass of its null image set (above 0, at most 2000)

params.name: label_discovery_min_share
params.description: Share of the counted spectra a -label_discovery_out peak needs

params.name: label_discovery_min_spectra
params.description: Spectra a -label_discovery_out peak or site candidate needs

params.name: label_discovery_out
params.description: Experimental: report every terminal or lysine mass offset the tag flanks carry, known or not, explained by residues, the known labels or Unimod, and a provisional label call (not validated on held-out data; format in doc/LABEL-DISCOVERY-REPORT.md)

params.name: label_discovery_unimod_top
params.description: Unimod alternatives -label_discovery_out lists per peak

params.name: label_discovery_window_c
params.description: Half-window of the C-terminal flank channel of -label_discovery_out; 0 = estimate it from the run

params.name: label_discovery_window_n
params.description: Half-window of the N-terminal flank channel of -label_discovery_out; 0 = estimate it from the run

params.name: label_out
params.description: Report N-terminal isobaric label gaps (TMT, TMTpro, iTRAQ4) and the heavy Lys8/Arg10 shares of the tag ends

params.name: log
params.description: Name of log file (created only when specified)

params.name: massgap_max_mods
params.description: Modifications combined to explain a gap

params.name: massgap_min_bin
params.description: Spectra a -delta_out row needs to take part in the gap peaks

params.name: massgap_min_share
params.description: Share of the placed spectra a gap peak needs

params.name: massgap_min_spectra
params.description: Spectra a gap peak needs

params.name: massgap_out
params.description: Report the -delta_out mass-gap distribution (requires -recon_out): Cys alkylation counts, gap peaks explained as combinations of Unimod modifications, and SILAC labels among them

params.name: massgap_silac_min
params.description: Shifted spectra a SILAC call needs

params.name: massgap_silac_share
params.description: Share of the shifted spectra a SILAC label needs

params.name: massgap_top
params.description: Modifications listed by share

params.name: massgap_window
params.description: Gap window of -massgap_out on a ppm run

params.name: massgap_window_da
params.description: Gap window of -massgap_out on a run with a Da fragment tolerance

params.name: max_evalue
params.description: E-value cutoff; 0 disables

params.name: max_peaks
params.description: Peaks kept per spectrum, at most 1024; 0 means 1024, not unlimited. Higher values use more memory. Also caps -peaks_per_window

params.name: max_tags
params.description: Tags reported per spectrum; 0 = unlimited

params.name: min_filter_length
params.description: Ignore tags shorter than this when matching against -fasta; 0 derives a floor from the database size

params.name: mzpeak_read_memory
params.description: Ignored; mzPeak is read in file order without a decode cache

params.name: no_deisotope
params.description: Do not collapse isotope clusters to their monoisotopic peak, and do not move multiply-charged fragments onto the singly-charged scale, before peak selection

params.name: no_progress
params.description: Disables progress logging to command line

params.name: orientation
params.description: Match a tag as written, or also reversed, against -fasta and in -recon_fasta reconciliation. Tags are stored N->C under a y-ion assumption, so b-derived tags read reversed

params.name: out
params.description: Tag list (tab-separated)

params.name: out_spectra
params.description: Write spectra carrying a reported tag here (mzML or mzpeak). Note this path holds one slot per input spectrum, so unlike the default it needs memory proportional to the FILE, not to the thread count

params.name: peaks_per_window
params.description: Keep this many peaks per 100 Da window instead of the strongest -max_peaks overall; 0 disables. Scales the effective peak budget with the spectrum's m/z range, so dense spectra are not starved and sparse ones not padded

params.name: pick_profile
params.description: Centroid profile MS2 (MS:1000128) with OpenMS PeakPickerHiRes before tagging: 'legacy' on mzPeak input only (as FASTag 1.11), 'auto' on mzML and mzPeak input (not MGF), 'off' never. Centroided MS2 are never re-picked; -out_spectra writes the spectra as they were tagged

params.name: pick_unknown_type
params.description: With -pick_profile auto, also centroid MS2 that declare no spectrum type (neither MS:1000127 nor MS:1000128) when OpenMS's PeakTypeEstimator reads their data as profile

params.name: probe_input
params.description: Print the metadata of this spectra file (mzML, mzpeak or MGF) as JSON lines and exit: instrument and MS2 analyzer, activation, spectrum counts, centroid/profile, mzML index state, the acquisition check's call and, with -fasta, its protein and decoy counts. A FASTA file (.fasta, .fa, .faa, .fas) alone gives only those counts. Reads metadata only; needs no -in or -out

params.name: proforma
params.description: Append a ProForma 2.0 column ([+nterm]-SEQ-[+cterm]) for each tag

params.name: progress
params.description: Emit 'FASTAG_PROGRESS done=<n> total=<n>' lines to stderr for a GUI progress bar

params.name: recon_fasta
params.description: Protein database for -recon_out. Default: the -fasta file

params.name: recon_id_out
params.description: The -recon_out placements as identifications (requires -recon_out), as idXML, mzid or mzTab by extension: one hit per placement with its proteins, the database peptide carrying only the fixed residue modifications, scored by the tag's E-value (lower is better), the mass gap as metadata. NOT FDR-controlled

params.name: recon_localize
params.description: Localize each -recon_out mass gap to one residue of its region: the site whose shifted b/y fragments match the most peaks within -fragment_tolerance. Appends loc_site (residue + 1-based protein position; the first on a tie), loc_score (b/y ion/charge matches) and loc_ties (sites sharing that score; 1 = unique)

params.name: recon_min_length
params.description: Shortest tag worth reconciling; 0 derives it from database size (the length where chance matches fall below 5%). Overridable because the floor is a noise gate, not a correctness rule

params.name: recon_missed_cleavages
params.description: Missed tryptic cleavages allowed in reconciliation windows (at most 10)

params.name: recon_out
params.description: Reconcile reported tags against a protein database and write one row per placement (protein, peptide, position, flank agreement, mass gap + interpretation). Uses -recon_fasta, or -fasta when that is not given

params.name: res_conf
params.description: Append a res_conf column: a confidence from 0 to 100 for each residue, N to C, space-separated (a gap's two residues share one score). Used for de novo assembly export (see README, Assembly export)

params.name: search_config_out
params.description: Search-engine configuration for -fasta_out (or the input database): Sage JSON, or Comet parameters (merged into -search_config_template when given)

params.name: search_config_template
params.description: Comet only: a `comet -p` parameter file the managed keys are merged into

params.name: search_decoy_prefix
params.description: Decoy prefix the engine generates; empty = rev_ (Sage) or DECOY_ (Comet)

params.name: search_engine
params.description: Engine of -search_config_out

params.name: search_isotope_errors
params.description: Precursor isotope errors 0..n the engine searches; 0 = none

params.name: search_precursor_tolerance
params.description: Precursor tolerance written to -search_config_out

params.name: search_precursor_unit
params.description: Unit of -search_precursor_tolerance

params.name: search_shifts
params.description: Add the run's mass-gap peaks to -search_config_out: 'variable' as variable modifications, 'offsets' as Comet mass offsets, 'both'. Isotope errors, fixed labels and caps are applied; -search_shifts_out lists every decision. Experimental

params.name: search_shifts_out
params.description: One row per mass-gap peak: its explanation and what -search_shifts did with it

params.name: shift_expand_sites
params.description: Add the residues -recon_localize places a variable shift on (unique sites only) to that modification

params.name: shift_max_offsets
params.description: Mass-gap peaks exported as Comet mass offsets besides 0, most spectra first

params.name: shift_max_variable
params.description: Mass-gap peaks exported as variable modifications, most spectra first

params.name: shift_site_min_count
params.description: Localized samples a residue needs for -shift_expand_sites

params.name: shift_site_min_ions
params.description: b/y ions a localized sample needs to count for -shift_expand_sites

params.name: shift_site_min_share
params.description: Share of a peak's localized samples a residue needs for -shift_expand_sites

params.name: shortlist_background
params.description: Proteins always appended to -fasta_out (host proteome, contaminants); decoys and entries already in the database are left out

params.name: shortlist_decoy_affix
params.description: Accession prefixes (ending in _) and suffixes (starting with _) that mark a decoy entry, case-insensitive; decoys never enter the shortlist or -fasta_out

params.name: shortlist_force
params.description: Write -fasta_out and -search_config_out although the tag ends call a protease the tryptic placement does not fit

params.name: shortlist_gapped
params.description: Let placements with one mismatched flank (a mass gap) count for the shortlist; by default only exact ones count (a gap equal to a fixed terminal label is exact)

params.name: shortlist_max_evalue
params.description: E-value a tag needs for its placements to count for the shortlist

params.name: shortlist_min_spectra
params.description: Spectra a protein needs to be kept

params.name: shortlist_out
params.description: Ranked protein shortlist from the tag placements on -recon_fasta (or -fasta): spectra, peptides, shared-spectrum weight and best E-value per protein, and whether it is kept. A search-space reduction, NOT FDR-controlled

params.name: shortlist_parsimony
params.description: 'none' keeps every protein above -shortlist_min_spectra; 'subset' drops a protein whose spectra a higher-ranked kept one has; 'greedy' keeps a greedy set cover of the spectra

params.name: shortlist_top
params.description: Keep at most this many proteins, ties at the cut kept; 0 = no cap

params.name: species
params.description: Infer which taxa are present from the tags. Uses the bundled taxonomy unless -taxdb/-taxonomy_* are given, and writes <out> with its extension replaced by .species.tsv unless -species_out is given

params.name: species_call
params.description: Call each taxon of the -species report present, no_call or not_detected: 'decoy' tests its count against a null of decoy tags (looked up like the tags) plus the spill expected from stronger related taxa, and appends the columns call, call_reason, decoy_spectra, decoy_expected, decoy_qvalue, share and lod. 'none' = the ranked report only

params.name: species_call_decoys
params.description: Decoy tags per tag for -species_call decoy

params.name: species_call_min_units
params.description: Fewer spectra with taxon evidence than this make -species_call decoy a run-level no_call (few_spectra)

params.name: species_call_params
params.description: Decision parameters of -species_call decoy (alpha, tau, n_min). Default: species_call.tsv in the taxonomy directory

params.name: species_deconvolve
params.description: Correct taxon counts for sequence shared between taxa, so a near neighbour cannot rank on a relative's evidence. Helps most when the true taxon's relatives are in the reference; can suppress genuine low-abundance taxa

params.name: species_evidence
params.description: Which of a spectrum's tags make it count for a taxon: 'best' = the taxa of its lowest-E-value tag that maps into the index (ties united); 'all' = the union over every reported tag (more chance hits)

params.name: species_max_kmer_share
params.description: Ignore k-mers carried by more than this fraction of the indexed taxa: a k-mer in most of the reference cannot tell taxa apart. 1 keeps all

params.name: species_min_len
params.description: Ignore tags shorter than this for taxonomy; 0 uses the index k

params.name: species_min_margin
params.description: Require a tag's best taxa to carry this fraction more of its k-mers than the runner-up, else the tag is too generic to be evidence. 0 keeps all

params.name: species_orientation
params.description: Which readings of a tag -species looks up: 'forward' = as written; 'both' = also reversed (a tag read from b ions is written reversed), using the one informative reading, or the taxa both share; a tag whose two readings share none is skipped. Independent of -orientation, which applies to -fasta and -recon_fasta only. Under 'both' the analytic log_pvalue and qvalue columns are NA (no analytic background follows); only decoy_qvalue and call from -species_call decoy are calibrated

params.name: species_out
params.description: Ranked taxa TSV. Default: <out> with its extension replaced by .species.tsv

params.name: species_pi0
params.description: Proportion of null taxa for the -species_call q-values: 1 = Benjamini-Hochberg; 0 estimates it from the run (Storey)

params.name: species_rank
params.description: Report taxa at this NCBI rank (genus, family, ...)

params.name: species_use_gapped
params.description: Let gapped tags contribute taxonomic evidence. Off because a gap is an inferred residue pair, and an exact k-mer lookup cannot tell an inferred residue from an observed one

params.name: stream
params.description: Resident single-spectrum mode: spectrum blocks on stdin, TSV rows + '#end' sentinels on stdout. Core tagging only (refuses -fasta, -entrapment_fasta, -species, -species_out, -taxdb, -glyco, -recon_out, -recon_id_out, -out_spectra, -delta_out, -digest_out, -label_out, -massgap_out, -usi_collection); parameter changes need a restart

params.name: subsample_fraction
params.description: Tag only this random fraction (0..1] of input spectra; 0 = all. Ignored when -subsample_spectra is set

params.name: subsample_seed
params.description: Seed for -subsample_* selection

params.name: subsample_spectra
params.description: Tag only this many randomly chosen input spectra; 0 = all. Takes precedence over -subsample_fraction

params.name: tag_length
params.description: Seed tag length in residues

params.name: tag_lengths
params.description: Seed tag lengths to run in one pass, replacing -tag_length. Each length is tagged, scored and capped (-max_tags) exactly as on its own; a spectrum's rows are those runs' rows in ascending length, except that a tag several lengths report is kept only from the length with its lowest E-value

params.name: taxdb
params.description: Tag->taxon index (built by buildtaxdb). Default: the bundled tax_k7.taxdb

params.name: taxonomy_names
params.description: NCBI taxonomy names.dmp. Default: the bundled names.dmp

params.name: taxonomy_nodes
params.description: NCBI taxonomy nodes.dmp. Default: the bundled nodes.dmp

params.name: test
params.description: Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

params.name: threads
params.description: Sets the number of threads allowed to be used by the TOPP tool (0 = all available cores)

params.name: unknown_charge
params.description: How a precursor without a charge is tagged: assume2 (as 2+, as before 1.12), enumerate (at each listed possible charge, else at every charge -charge_min..-charge_max) or infer (at the charge its complement pairs support; both of two close calls; 1+ when 1 is a candidate and almost no intensity lies above the precursor; without evidence 2+, or the lowest candidate when 2 is none). Every charge tagged is a listed possible charge, else one of -charge_min..-charge_max. With several, E-values are multiplied by their number and the reports count the charge-evidence choice only. A header charge is never replaced

params.name: usi_collection
params.description: Append a usi column: each tag's spectrum as a HUPO-PSI Universal Spectrum Identifier, mzspec:<id>:<run>:scan:<n> (or the nativeId/index form USI 1.0 prescribes), where <run> is the input file name without its extension (an MGF keeps its .mgf) and <id> the dataset's PXD/MSV/RPXD/RMSV/PXL identifier, or USI000000 until it has one

params.name: variable_modifications
params.description: Variable modifications by OpenMS/UniMod name, e.g. 'Phospho (S)' 'Phospho (T)' 'Phospho (Y)' 'Formyl (K)'. Add a modified alternative, written inline as X[Name]

params.name: version
params.description: Version of the tool that generated this parameters file.
